title: Ask for the saint who can show the way
summary: Peace begins when the heart asks plainly to be shown the way. Take the question into sangat.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it instead of asking isolation to save you.

source.shortMeaning: Peace begins when the heart asks plainly to be shown the way.
source.lifeApplication: When confusion multiplies methods, ask to be shown the way instead of pretending you know.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace begins when the heart asks plainly to be shown the way.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: ask for the guidance that can lead you through ego's curtain.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it instead of asking isolation to save you.
